methodology: Source confirms described event or legal stage only; independent implementation, attribution, durability and cost assessment remain open. These are candidates, not verified influence outcomes.

cases.caveat: Shared commitments do not by themselves prove US-caused policy change.

cases.title: EU Artificial Intelligence Act enters into force
